svg.title: TOPAK B7 — From genesis to bootstrap: where the corpus stands at G9
svg.desc: The design process is genesis, not a degeneracy (ADR-0029): one custodian ratifies, the risky part is tracked as debt, and the anchor may bootstrap once a drafted TLA+ specification exists and the whole corpus has been independently reviewed. This is the G9 state (2026.10.02); diagrams/g1-to-bootstrap-2026.09.18.svg shows the earlier G1 state.
svg.text: TOPAK · B7

text.tspan: From genesis to bootstrap: where the corpus stands at G9

svg.text: The design process is genesis, not a degeneracy (ADR-0029): one custodian ratifies, the risky part is tracked as debt, and the anchor may bootstrap once a drafted TLA+ specification exists and the whole corpus has been independently reviewed. This is the G9 state (2026.10.02); diagrams/g1-to-bootstrap-2026.09.18.svg shows the earlier G1 state.
Custody declared: Scott, sole custodian, (1, 0) (§1). Genesis custody, not a degeneracy: no
archetype custody exists before the anchor does.
Unilateral ratification of any record with decision text (§2); a record without it cannot be ratified.
Ratification is available, not required.
Everything ratified is trusted by declaration and joins the genesis TCB.
No forcing function (§7): genesis may last indefinitely; every checkpoint carries a debt ledger.
(a) and (b) met
(a) a drafted TLA+ bootstrap specification: five modules, five invariants, a mutation each that
must fail (§5). TLC checking recommended, not required. Two of five drafted, checked and,
since G8, proved (ADR-0046 §4).
(b) an independent review of the entire corpus at one named manifest digest, by at least one
reviewer who is not the author, every finding dispositioned (A2.1). Not met: nothing at G9 is
independently reviewed (G9 §8).
Permission, not obligation: bootstrap happens when the custodian declares it and the trigger
is met (§7).
custodian declares
Seat the key-holders under a declared custody record.
Assemble the genesis bundle (contents below).
Every key-holder signs its digest. That is issuance epoch 0, the root of the rules-epoch
chain (ADR-0027 §4).
The genesis bundle is the only artifact never promoted; the genesis rules are checked by
GenesisSatisfiesFloor, not a promotion (ADR-0027 §2).
epoch 0 issued
Each confirmation-required record passes a confirmation promotion under ADR-0024 with
author recusal, in dependency order (§6).
Confirmed: becomes Accepted; the marker is removed. Rejected: a superseding record is
required.
Unmarked genesis records get no confirmation promotion; their review happened at the gate
The bootstrap set (0024–0027) can never carry the marker: confirmation runs under it (§4).
18 unmarked + 22 confirmation-required; 2 ratified in part: ADR-0022 and ADR-0042, each
without §6
As at G8, the last added ADR-0046 (C2, C4), Batch 25. ADR-0034 A2, pending, adds no
record
ADR-0005 (blocked on a decision), ADR-0035, ADR-0036 (on evidence and a review); and
ADR-0011 tombstone; ADR-0014 reserved, no file

45 record files, numbered to 0046; 0014 is the only reserved number. Four pending amendments, up from one: ADR-0026 A1 (R8), none of its four conditions met; ADR-0033 A7 and A8; ADR-0034 A2 (C2, C4). Since G8 only Batch 26, ADR-0046 E1, is ratified. Ratified in part is distinct from ADR-0018, which is accepted and reversed in part by ADR-0037 §3 (G9 §1.2, unchanged from G8).

svg.text: 0013, 0028, and the accepted 0006 and 0009

C3 · supersedes, or reverses in effect, an accepted record

svg.text: 0013 (debts of 0006 and 0009)

Marked on ratification if any applies. Until confirmed, a publication citing the guarantee says "author-ratified". Minimum set: 0013, 0028, 0015, 0022 §6 (whenever ratified), the two supersession records (whenever written), 0006 and 0009
retroactively.
Ratified by the custodian and trusted by declaration. Post-bootstrap it changes only through promotion.
As above, plus a confirmation promotion after bootstrap (§6).
Unratified; may stay Proposed indefinitely.

Markings with no criterion: ADR-0035 R2 (Proposed) is confirmation-required by custodian instruction; and four ratified texts were drafted by the assistant (ADR-0044, ADR-0045, ADR-0030 A1, ADR-0046), and three pending ones (ADR-0034
A2, ADR-0033 A7 and A8), for which ADR-0029 has no criterion (G9 item 66).

text.tspan: The genesis debt ledger: all 22 confirmation-required records (G9 §4, as at G8)

svg.text: Topic per principal per round, sealed on emit, as the unit of erasure
C1 · A2 only
A2 adds the after companion topic to the unit of erasure: a claim over the erasure path
Erasure is a privileged, modeled, consensus-ordered event
Marked retroactively under C1 (ADR-0029 §4 minimum set); its debt resolved by ADR-0013
Break-glass is a modeled, quorum-witnessed path, not a prohibition
As ADR-0006: a privileged path; its debt resolved by ADR-0013
Exception mechanism for privileged paths through the floor
Proof obligation over privileged paths; resolves the debts of 0006 and 0009. NC-1 and NC-2 checked and, since B25, proved; author-run
Effects are boundary crossings; every crossing is authorized, ordered, and auditable
Both sets claimed exhaustive; the effect set's exhaustiveness unenforced while the sandbox gap stands
Build emits to the effect stream; Build has an Observer
ADR-0039 §3, accepted, couples Build's promotion to the seal this record defines
Degeneracy as the deployment-variation relation; archetype as its unique maximum
§5 reverses in effect ADR-0008's Observer scoping and ADR-0017's ordering-primacy clause
The forensic floor: authority facts survive erasure and break-glass
Proof obligation over privileged paths; four open obligations carried into confirmation
The design process is genesis; unilateral ratification; bootstrap on a drafted TLA+ spec
C3 · A2 only
A2 reverses in effect two clauses of this record: the full-corpus review
Bundles cannot add authority by construction; the floor runs on a verified evaluator
Floor exceptions and forensic classes re-expressed in the floor language; now carries A1, the checker as a trust root and the solver trusted for nothing
The lease is the composite credential, and its grant is the instant
§5 lapses break-glass approvals on a targeted revocation; A1 says how a confinement claim survives renewal
Confinement is attested at lease grant; the archetype rung is a confidential VM
09.28 · B10; A2 pending
A confinement claim; resolves ADR-0031's attestation-rung debt. A2, the Run profile, pending, would carry C2 and C4 on a record already marked with both
The LTRO decomposes into principals: seats and stages
§3 reverses in effect ADR-0018's Reader scope correction; resolves seat-scoping debts
Observers are per cell, the shared group becomes the correlator
Supersedes ADR-0008; discharges ADR-0023's carried scope for that supersession
Observer liveness is progress, not presence
Resolves ADR-0024's open obligation on veto-seat outage
Run has its own alphabet: Consult, Actuate, Report
Reverses in effect ADR-0022 §5's sentence that Read and Emit are common; resolves ADR-0030's debt
Policy obligations for Run: one envelope per variant, coupling on effects only
§3 restates break-glass over a renamed action; resolves ADR-0039 finding 2
Mechanism obligations for Run (§1–§5, §7, §8 only; §6 Proposed)
Resolves ADR-0039 finding 3 in part; §6, Run's confinement claim, left out of ratification
Cell obligations for Run
Resolves the provisional Run column of ADR-0037 §4
A bundle is trusted by its signature, not its file name
§3 is a check on the privileged path. Drafted by the assistant
The trusted base is declared row by row
Annex A claims to enumerate what the theorems assume; resolves debts of 0030, 0034, 0036, 0037, 0042, 0043. Drafted by the assistant; new at G7. T-0045-31 added by its B25 dependent entry
The formal layer's method is declared: TLC checks mutations and witnesses at small constants, TLAPS proves the invariants, and the
prover is a trusted-base row

§4 claims that every invariant the thirteen modules state is proved (exhaustiveness); resolves MAP 2.3 and the method half of CR-4. Drafted by the assistant; new at G8. E1 (G9): RulesFloorBase.tla is live, not frozen; erratum-class, nothing to
review

The bootstrap set, ADR-0024 to ADR-0027, is Accepted with no marker and cannot carry one. Since A2 it is reached by the bootstrap review with everything else, before the rules it defines take effect: a reader, not a confirmation promotion. ADR-0029 itself is marked for A2 only. Batch 25 added dependent entries to 0013, 0026, 0029, 0030, 0031, 0034, 0037, 0038, 0039, 0041, 0042, 0043 (the proofs of their modules' invariants) and 0045 (T-0045-31); no decision text changed in any of them, so

what the first quorum reviews in them is unchanged from G7 (G8 §4, §6). Since G8 (highlighted): Batch 26 ratified ADR-0046 E1, erratum-class, which adds nothing to review, and ADR-0034 gained A2, pending (G9 §4, §6).

text.tspan: What the trigger and the ceremony need

svg.text: Not drafted: waits on the genesis rules contents. Its shape is a lemma in both proofs below, proved of
the floor's definition and not of genesis contents (G9 §4, as at G8)
Drafted and checked 2026.09.23, TLC2 2.19, floor as ratified (R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9); proved
2026.10.02, Anchor_proof.tla, 40 obligations, for every floor subset and epoch bound
Not drafted: waits on modeling decisions about epochs, the vote triple and veto seats. Invariant
renamed by A1 from NoPromotionWithoutAllGrantSeats
Not drafted: same decisions, and a model of deciding before committing, which the reference had to
implement
Drafted and checked 2026.09.23; proved 2026.10.02, BreakGlass_proof.tla, 37 obligations
Bootstrap specification: partial, as at G8 (G9 §4): two of five modules, Anchor and BreakGlass, are proved and not only checked; Genesis, RulesFloor and Promotion are still owed. Both proofs
extend RulesFloorBase.tla, which is live, not frozen (ADR-0046 E1): when R8 changes it, they go stale and need successors. RulesFloorNV and its rev5 rerun are precursors, not substitutes. The
ceremony accepts a specification digest marked drafted-only.

text.tspan: The genesis bundle (§5 with A2.2; ToO §9)

svg.text: The corpus manifest at bootstrap, including the confirmation-required set
The TLA+ specification digest, marked checked or drafted-only
The review attestation (A2.2): reviewers, manifest digest reviewed, scope, findings disposition
The genesis rules, which issue no erasure roster; resident with the mechanism release (ADR-0027)
The trusted-base declaration beside the custody record, now that ADR-0045 is in force: the five modules rest on its rung-0 rows
Every key-holder signs the digest → issuance epoch 0. Without the attestation it is not a bootstrap
ADR-0029 Consequences; ADR-0026 §6 finding 5; ToO §9
anchor key-holders
counted grant seats
R2 minGrant ≥ 2
humans
disjoint by R5
Six if the author holds a seat: recusal raises the roster to three. Four was a property of the 09.15 model (custody (1, 0)), and too few
to check R1 (09.23). A solo bootstrap is not a bootstrap, and custody today is (1, 0).

Debts no confirmation repays are carried beside the ledger (G9 §4). Those of G2 to G8 stand, among them the checker's authorship (the proof-rule signature in tools/cpc/ is cvc5's own formalization, trusted as written), the prover's soundness trusted as written (item 74) and the proofs the same hand's (G8). G9 adds two: three pending texts and the code under them are the same hand's, drafted, built, checked, mutation-tested, proved and regenerated by the

assistant in one day, with no second reader; and six choices of the reference were accepted in conversation, not by ratification (G9 §1.2, item 85). Four ratified texts and three pending ones were drafted by the assistant. The debt is visible, not bounded.

Sources: ADR-0029 §1–§7, A1, A2 (A2.1–A2.5), Options, Consequences; ADR-0024 §6; ADR-0025 Annex A-0025; ADR-0026 §2 R2, R5, §6 finding 5, §7 finding 3; ADR-0027 §2, §4; ADR-0033 A7, A8 (pending); ADR-0034 A2 (pending); ADR-0035 Status note; ADR-0045 Annex A, T-0045-31; ADR-0046 §4, B25, E1 (B26); every listed record's Status line and Status note; decisions/README.md; G8 §4; G9 header, §1, §1.1, §1.2, §4, §6, §7 items 8, 66, 74, 85, §8; ToO rev 13 §0, §7.1, §7.4, §9; spec/README.md;
